name: BVM Construction, LLC
what_they_do: Dumpster rental, junk and construction-debris removal, residential/commercial clean-outs and excavation (land clearing, concrete and asphalt removal, site prep). Site displays NJDEP #0034992 and NJ contractor licence #13VH07299500 and says the company was founded in East Brunswick, NJ.
customers: Homeowners doing clean-outs or renovations, and commercial/general contractors needing roll-offs and site prep in Middlesex County.

size_signals.signal: Photo of four roll-off trucks and dumpsters in the company yard - a real fleet, not a broker
NJDEP registration #0034992 and NJ licence #13VH07299500 shown in the site header; hours 07:00-16:00

listing.platform: none confirmed (no Google rating surfaced in searches; YellowPages/BuildZoom profiles exist without visible ratings)

website_review.primary_cta: 'GET A FREE QUOTE' (links to tel:) plus two on-page quote forms
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Two on-page forms: a short contact form (Name, Email*) and a longer quote form (Name, Email*, Phone, Address, Message, file upload for photos); both are reCAPTCHA-protected
website_review.trust_signals: Licence and NJDEP numbers in the header, photos of the actual trucks and excavation projects, FAQ section, 'our story' with community involvement (UNICEF), years-in-business not stated
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright still reads 2025; site is a single-page GoDaddy builder template with no service or town pages; phone number is only in the contact blocks, not in a header bar
website_review.search_basics: Title/description name junk removal but not the town; no separate pages for dumpster rental, excavation or the towns served; no schema markup at all; footer/site address is East Brunswick, not Spotswood
top_issues: Single page for four distinct services (dumpster rental, junk removal, clean-outs, excavation) - nothing to rank for each service or town
Zero structured data: no LocalBusiness/Service JSON-LD, no hours or service-area markup
Both quote forms sit behind reCAPTCHA ('This site is protected by reCAPTCHA'), so an agent cannot submit a quote request
No prices or size/price ranges for dumpsters, and no service-area list in readable text
Copyright year stale at 2025 and no header phone bar on mobile

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: no Google Business Profile rating found in searches, so completeness cannot be confirmed; site does not block crawlers per its own hosting (GoDaddy); robots.txt not separately verified. Answerable: services and hours (07:00-16:00) are in readable text with licence numbers, but there is no JSON-LD, no price/size ranges for dumpsters and no service-area list. Bookable: real labelled fields (Name, Email*, Phone, Address, Message, photo upload) and click-to-call, but reCAPTCHA plus no online scheduling means an agent must fall back to a human.

operations_signals.signal: Quote form accepts a photo/file upload and address, implying each enquiry needs a human to size the dumpster and price it - a classic manual estimate queue
FAQ on the page answers pricing, availability, dumpster sizes and prohibited items - repeated questions staff answer by phone

top_opportunities.opportunity: Split the single page into service pages (dumpster rental, junk removal, clean-outs, excavation) with town-level landing copy for Spotswood/East Brunswick/Old Bridge and add LocalBusiness + Service schema
top_opportunities.evidence: One-page GoDaddy site, no service or town pages, no JSON-LD, titles omit the town

top_opportunities.opportunity: Quote-intake agent that reads the form/photo, asks for dumpster size and access details, and replies with an estimate range plus a booked drop-off window
top_opportunities.evidence: Quote form collects address, message and a file upload; pricing FAQ exists but no published ranges, so every quote is manual

top_opportunities.opportunity: Remove the reCAPTCHA from the quote path (or add a server-side alternative) and publish dumpster sizes with price ranges so an agent can quote without a human
top_opportunities.evidence: Both forms state 'This site is protected by reCAPTCHA'; no dollar figures appear anywhere on the page

scores.reasons: Gap: one page, no schema, no service pages, CAPTCHA-gated forms and no prices - a lot missing for a business with real trucks. Pay: fleet-owning contractor with licence, dumpster rentals are a decent-ticket recurring service. Ease: needs content and page-building rather than a config tweak. Evidence: the site itself is well documented; the missing piece is the Google listing and revenue detail.
